plan_needed: A licensed user on Zoom Workplace Pro, Pro Plus, Business, Business Plus, Enterprise, Enterprise Plus or Enterprise Bundle, with a Zoom account owner or admin with privileges, and meeting summary and smart recording switched on. A Claude account; Zoom's page doesn't name a Claude plan. On Claude Team or Enterprise an Owner adds the connector first.

steps.where: Claude (claude.ai or the desktop app), Customize
steps.do: Go to Customize > Connectors and select Discover.
steps.see: The Connectors directory opens.

steps.do: Search for Zoom for Claude (made by Zoom, Anthropic verified), open it and select Connect to Claude.
steps.see: You're sent to Zoom to sign in.

steps.do: Sign in to Zoom and approve the access requested.
steps.see: You're returned to Claude. The exact Zoom approval screen isn't described in the docs we read.

steps.do: Select + in the message box, then Connectors, and switch Zoom on.
steps.see: Zoom is available in this conversation.

steps.do: Ask about a recorded meeting, for example its action items, or ask Claude to make a Zoom Doc of them.
steps.see: Claude answers from meeting summaries, transcripts and recordings you hosted or were given access to. Zoom's example says Claude confirms before creating a new Zoom Doc.

undo.do: Select the Zoom connector, then Disconnect, or use the three-dot menu to Remove it.
undo.see: Claude is signed out of Zoom.

undo.do: Click the More icon next to the app, then Remove, and confirm.
undo.see: The app is removed from your Zoom account.

plan_needed: Zoom Canvas enabled, a Zoom account owner or admin with privileges (non-admins can add it only if the app is pre-approved in the Zoom Marketplace), a Claude account, and permission to connect third-party apps if your organisation manages that.

steps.do: Click Customize, then Connectors.
steps.see: Your connectors list.

steps.do: Click the add icon, then Browse connectors. Search for Zoom Canvas and click Connect.
steps.see: You're sent to the Zoom Canvas for Claude page in the Zoom Marketplace. Zoom says the sign-in must start from Claude.

steps.do: Click Add at the top right, confirm the permissions and click Allow.
steps.see: You're redirected back to Claude.

steps.do: Complete the authorisation. Then in a chat click the add icon, then Connectors, and check the Zoom Canvas toggle is on.
steps.see: Claude can create, edit, share and manage Canvas files you have rights to. Zoom's examples show it renaming a file once you confirm.

undo.do: Find and select Zoom Canvas, then click Remove.
undo.see: Claude can no longer reach your Canvas files.

plan_needed: A licensed user on Zoom Workplace Pro, Pro Plus, Business, Business Plus, Enterprise, Enterprise Plus or Enterprise Bundle, a Zoom account owner or admin with privileges, and a ChatGPT account. Meeting summary or smart recording must be on. The Ask tool needs a ZoomMate or Custom AI Companion licence. OpenAI says some workspaces need admin approval.

steps.do: Sign in, click your name, then Settings.
steps.see: ChatGPT settings.

steps.do: Click Apps & Connectors, then Zoom, then Connect. (OpenAI's current help pages call this area Plugins.)
steps.see: You're sent to the Zoom for ChatGPT page in the Zoom Marketplace.

steps.do: Click Add at the top right, confirm the permissions and click Allow.
steps.see: You're redirected back to ChatGPT.

steps.do: Complete the authorisation.
steps.see: Zoom is connected.

steps.do: Click the add icon, then More, then Zoom. Or type @Zoom or /Zoom, then ask for a meeting recap.
steps.see: ChatGPT answers from your Zoom meeting assets. Before creating a Zoom Canvas doc it asks you to confirm, and creates it only after you click Create.

undo.see: Future access stops. Past chats and memories aren't deleted automatically.

undo.do: Click Manage, then Added Apps, then Remove next to Zoom for ChatGPT.
undo.see: The app is removed from your Zoom account. (Zoom's general Marketplace article calls this area My Library.)

plan_needed: A paid Zoom Workplace Pro, Pro Plus, Business, Business Plus, Enterprise, Enterprise Plus or Enterprise Bundle account, Zoom Whiteboard enabled, access to ChatGPT connectors, and permission to connect third-party apps if your organisation manages that.

steps.do: Sign in, click your name, then Settings, then Apps & Connectors.
steps.see: The list of apps.

steps.do: Find and click Zoom Whiteboard, then click Connect.
steps.see: You're sent to the Zoom Whiteboard for ChatGPT page in the Zoom Marketplace.

steps.do: Click Add at the top right, confirm the permissions and click Allow.
steps.see: You're redirected back to ChatGPT, where you complete the authorisation.

steps.do: Make sure the Zoom Whiteboard connector is on for the conversation, then describe the whiteboard you want.
steps.see: ChatGPT shows a preview when available. It can also update or delete whiteboards and change collaborators, depending on your permission settings.

undo.do: Find and click Zoom Whiteboard, then click Remove.
undo.see: ChatGPT can no longer reach your whiteboards.

plan_needed: A Microsoft 365 Copilot account with administrator privileges to deploy the app, a Zoom account owner or admin with privileges, and meeting summary or smart recording switched on. Agentic search needs a ZoomMate licence.

steps.do: Sign in with your administrator account, click Show all, then Settings, then Integrated apps.
steps.see: The Integrated apps page.

steps.do: Select Get Apps (or View more apps), search for Zoom for Cowork and select it.
steps.see: The app's information, permissions and terms.

steps.do: Review the permissions and terms, choose Everyone or Specific users/groups, and click Deploy. Then click Next and finish the wizard.
steps.see: A confirmation that the app was deployed.

steps.do: Click Cowork at the top left, then the plugin icon (a puzzle piece), and check Zoom is switched on.
steps.see: You're asked to sign in to Zoom.

steps.do: Sign in to your Zoom account and click Allow.
steps.see: Copilot can search your Zoom meetings. Before creating a Zoom Canvas doc of action items, Copilot asks you to confirm and creates it after you click Create.

undo.where: Microsoft 365 admin center, Settings > Integrated apps
undo.do: Select the Zoom app, click Remove, then click Remove again to confirm.
undo.see: The app is removed for your organisation.

plan_needed: An AI administrator for the Microsoft 365 tenant, a paid Zoom Business or Enterprise plan with cloud recording enabled, and a Zoom account administrator to sign in and consent. Microsoft says the connector's app in the Zoom Marketplace isn't currently available in the EU.

steps.where: Microsoft 365 admin center, Zoom Meetings connector
steps.do: Start setting up the Zoom Meetings connector and accept or change its display name.
steps.see: The connector setup page. Microsoft's page doesn't say exactly where in the admin center you start.

steps.do: Select OAuth 2.0, then Authorize, and sign in with a Zoom administrator account. Complete the consent screen.
steps.see: The connector can reach the Zoom APIs it needs.

steps.do: Optionally switch on Rollout to limited audience and choose users and groups.
steps.see: Only those people get the connector at first.

steps.do: Tick the box next to the Notice section, then choose Create.
steps.see: Indexing starts right away. By default only each meeting's owner can see its content, with a check for changes every 15 minutes and a full crawl daily.

steps.where: Microsoft 365 admin center, Copilot > Connectors > Your connections
steps.do: Confirm the connection state is Ready, then ask a Zoom host to ask Copilot about one of their recent recorded meetings.
steps.see: Copilot's answer cites the Zoom Meetings connection.

undo.do: Microsoft's Zoom Meetings connector page doesn't describe removing the connection.

plan_needed: A Zoom account with admin or developer rights, a Zoom app created in the Zoom App Marketplace, licences for the Zoom products you use, and access to Claude's custom connectors or ChatGPT's Developer mode. Suits someone with developer skills.

steps.do: Select Develop, then Build app, choose General app and click Create.
steps.see: Your new app's configuration screen.

steps.do: Click Scopes, then Add scopes. Choose what the app may do, then click Done.
steps.see: The app has the permissions the Zoom MCP server's tools need.

steps.do: Click +, then Add custom connector. Enter a name, the Zoom MCP server URL, and the app's OAuth client ID and secret, then click Add.
steps.see: In your Zoom app, set the OAuth redirect URL under Basic Information > OAuth Information to https://claude.ai/api/mcp/auth_callback.

steps.do: Turn on Developer mode and click Confirm. Click Create app, enter a name and the MCP server URL, and choose OAuth. Under OAuth > Advanced settings > Client registration, choose User-Defined OAuth Client and the client_secret_basic method.
steps.see: Copy ChatGPT's callback value into the OAuth redirect URL field of your Zoom app.

steps.do: Connect and sign in to Zoom when asked.
steps.see: The tools for that Zoom product area become available. Zoom's servers don't support automatic client registration, so each app is set up by hand.

undo.do: Select the custom connector and remove it from the three-dot menu.
undo.see: Claude stops using the Zoom MCP server. Zoom's MCP guide doesn't describe the Zoom side.
